seoCopy: Violet Gold Vine combines a rich violet blouse with antique-gold floral vines, leaf motifs and linear stone embellishment across the sleeves. The listed work type includes Aari embroidery, gold threadwork and stone and bead embellishment; the exact materials and their placement should be confirmed for your order. The design carries the botanical motif around the neckline, sleeve edges and blouse borders, with a coordinating back detail shown in the product images. Violet, purple, gold, cream and selected contrasting silk sarees can complement the palette, but compare the actual saree fabric, zari and jewellery before choosing. The listed starting price is ₹6,999 for hand embroidery on a customer-supplied blouse or garment. Garment cost, courier and additional material changes beyond the listed design are quoted separately. The listing makes no fixed turnaround promise. Include your event date, garment readiness and preferred coverage in the brief; the studio will review the design scope and current workload, then confirm a feasible crafting timeline before proceeding.
summary: A rich violet blouse featuring linear stone embellishment on the sleeves and intricate antique-gold floral vine embroidery.
description: This violet blouse pairs rows of fine linear embellishment across the sleeves with ornate gold-toned floral vines and leaf motifs along the sleeve edges, neckline and blouse borders. The back features a wide U-shaped opening, matching embroidered floral detailing and a violet tie finished with decorative drop tassels. The overall look balances detailed sleeve work with delicate botanical embroidery.
